mainEntity.name: What data does AI SEO analyze for plastic surgery practices?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI SEO analyzes a broad range of data to optimize a plastic surgery practice's online presence. This includes keyword search volume and intent, competitor website structure and backlink profiles, technical SEO aspects of your own site (e.g., site speed, mobile-friendliness), user behavior on your website (e.g., bounce rate, time on page), and local search queries. It also processes patient review sentiment, social media trends, and algorithm updates to provide a comprehensive, data-driven optimization strategy.
